description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling Android drawable resource files, including checking if a file is a drawable resource and retrieving possible root tags based on SDK version.

classes.name: AndroidDrawableDomUtil
classes.description: Utility class for Android drawable resource file operations, including identifying drawable files and getting drawable root tags based on SDK version.

methods.name: isDrawableResourceFile
methods.description: Checks if the given XML file is a drawable resource file.

methods.name: getPossibleRoots
methods.description: Returns a list of possible root tags for drawable resources based on the SDK version.
